description: Fit a trend to each Pokémon's monthly usage across a range and list the fastest rising, fastest declining and most volatile. These are descriptive trends, not forecasts. Needs at least three months of history in the range; with so few points, treat the result as a direction, not a measurement.

format.description: Regulation id from list_formats. Defaults to "champions-regmc" (Pokémon Champions — Regulation M-C).

from.description: First month, YYYY-MM. The nearest month with data is used if it has none

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (1–25). Defaults to 10

months.description: Months to look back from `to` when `from` is omitted. Defaults to 6

to.description: Last month, YYYY-MM. Defaults to the most recent month

name: get_usage_momentum

accelerating.description: True if the rise or decline is steeper in the later half of the range

slopePointsPerMonth.description: Fitted change in usage per month, in percentage points

format.description: Regulation id the result applies to

accelerating.description: True if the rise or decline is steeper in the later half of the range

slopePointsPerMonth.description: Fitted change in usage per month, in percentage points

volatilityPoints.description: Standard deviation of month-to-month change, in points

title: Find rising and falling Pokémon
